item.title: Studio Art
item.description: Studio Art Areas of Study Studio courses engage traditional and new methods of art-making in the process of creating original work. Our studio art majors have developed careers as professional artists, illustrators, photographers and arts administrators. Majors and minors have also found their critical thinking skills highly transferable to fields such as architecture, law, medicine, finance and retail. The areas of study include: Digital Media Drawing Painting Photography Printmaking Sculpture

item.description: Theatre Areas of Study Students interested in majoring in Theatre can choose either a Performance or Design emphasis. Students interested in minoring in Dance will complete six courses (see Dance Minor). Students can complete both a major in Theatre and a minor in Dance. Please note, students cannot double-count a course to fulfill requirements in both programs. item.title: Elementary Education Graduate Opportunity
item.description: Elementary Education Graduate Opportunity Completing the 4+1 Program As a Holy Cross sophomore, you’ll declare your education minor. As a junior, you’ll apply to the Master’s program at Clark University (3.0 GPA required). As a senior, you’ll take two graduate level classes at Clark. You will begin your Master of Arts in Teaching program full-time in May after your Holy Cross graduation. The 4+1 Program is a unique program solely for Holy Cross students. You'll also benefit from a $0 Application
